'''Elarea Aldraste''', also called "'''The Red Huntress'''," was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A moderately successful [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] hunter operating in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], she had a reputation for preferring her targets dead instead of alive.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: The Red Huntress}}</ref> Around [[3631 BBY]] she took control of the [[Crimson Fang]] gang, which following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] took over [[Port Nowhere]] by force, planning to use the mobile space station as their base of operations. The Alliance sent a [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit|strike team]] on a [[Battle of Port Nowhere|mission]] to liberate Port Nowhere, who systematically rid the station of Outer Rim's most notorious villains, eventually confronting The Red Huntress and killing her.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elarea Aldraste appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss during the "Crimson Fang" Uprising.
